description: The ONLY IPC granted to the remote Verse page (http://127.0.0.1:7777, the local sidecar's own origin, which the CSP already pins). Three window-chrome commands and nothing else: dragging the window by its top strip, double-click-to-zoom on that strip, and emitting the `shell-theme` event so the native window background can match the UI and dark mode does not flash white on the next launch. Deliberately excluded: every shell:* permission (an XSS in the console must not become command execution), the updater, the filesystem, and app show/hide. Do not widen this list — put new native behaviour behind a window event evaluated from Rust instead (see shell_contract.rs).
